mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_qualification_state_change(change_id, qualification_id, from_status, to_status, decision_id, reason_code, trigger_type, trigger_id, actor_id, aggregate_version, occurred_time, create_time) VALUES(#{row.changeId}, #{row.qualificationId}, #{row.fromStatus}, #{row.toStatus}, #{row.decisionId}, #{row.reasonCode}, #{row.triggerType}, #{row.triggerId}, #{row.actorId}, #{row.aggregateVersion}, #{row.occurredTime}, #{row.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT change_id AS changeId, qualification_id AS qualificationId, from_status AS fromStatus, to_status AS toStatus, decision_id AS decisionId, reason_code AS reasonCode, trigger_type AS triggerType, trigger_id AS triggerId, actor_id AS actorId, aggregate_version AS aggregateVersion, occurred_time AS occurredTime, create_time AS createTime FROM t_qualification_state_change WHERE qualification_id = #{qualificationId} AND aggregate_version = #{version}

SELECT change_id AS changeId, qualification_id AS qualificationId, from_status AS fromStatus, to_status AS toStatus, decision_id AS decisionId, reason_code AS reasonCode, trigger_type AS triggerType, trigger_id AS triggerId, actor_id AS actorId, aggregate_version AS aggregateVersion, occurred_time AS occurredTime, create_time AS createTime FROM t_qualification_state_change WHERE qualification_id = #{qualificationId} ORDER BY aggregate_version DESC
